decided_by: user 2026-10-05: one rule for every team size; never choose k separately for A and B

rule.k_role: k_role(N) = max(1, floor(N/3 + 1/2)); integer form max(1, (2N + 3) // 6)
rule.menu: K(N) = {0, k_role(N)}: 0 = plain specialists (no roles); k_role(N) = defender-only construction with k_role(N) defenders
rule.selection: S(k) = [V(A,k,Pole A) + V(B,k,Pole B)] / 2; k* = argmax S(k), exact tie -> smaller k; k_A = k_B = k* always
rule.forbidden: strategy-specific role counts; any (k_A, k_B) with k_A != k_B; any menu other than K(N)

why: the rule depends only on team size and is fixed before any 2v2/6v6 role outcome; it keeps roughly the same organizational share as N grows (1 of 2, 1 of 4, 2 of 6) instead of a fixed count; it is the R1 count rule already used at 4v4
consistency: 4v4 already ran with K(4) = {0,1} under SPECIALIST_QUALIFICATION_V1_SPEC (k* = 0 sealed); this record only fixes 2v2 and 6v6 to the same rule
